entry.title: Downrush 0.1.0
entry.summary: Downrush is a polyphonic synth for standalone Akai MPCs and the Force. It runs the synth engine of the open-source Deluge community firmware (v1.3.0) and plays Deluge SYNTH preset files with the firmware's own signal processing: subtractive, FM and ring mod, sample oscillators, a 24-cable mod matrix, arpeggiator, the firmware's effects and reverb. **This is a preview.** The list of parameters may still change, and a project saved with it may not reload correctly in a later version.
